_comment: Obsidian MCP server config. Merge the 'mcpServers' entry into your own
~/.claude/mcp.json (or add it with: claude mcp add). NEVER commit a real
API key — OBSIDIAN_API_KEY below is a placeholder.
Prerequisites you must do by hand (no agent can do them for you):
1. Install the Obsidian desktop app and open your vault in it.
2. Community plugins -> browse -> install and enable 'Local REST API'.
3. Open its settings, copy the API key, and paste it below.
The server talks to https://127.0.0.1:27124 — Obsidian's Local REST API
on the loopback interface. On a machine where Claude Code and Obsidian
share one loopback (i.e. anything that is not WSL talking to a Windows
Obsidian) that is all it takes; no port bridge is involved.
